reviews.title: Great for Ryzen on b550
reviews.comment: Easy setup and Worked out of the box and stable at rated speeds and timings on a Gigabyte ultra durable line b550 matx motherboard in dual channel with 2 sticks. Tested with a r5 3600 and paired with a r7 5700x3d for final configuration and build. Saw no issues with stability despite being faster than recommended. Was on motherboards memory qvl, so I'm not too surprised. Looks alright and is low enough profile that it doesn't stop you from using a larger air cooler like a thermalright peerless assassin 120 SE.
reviews.author: Robert Schwab

reviews.title: Low profile, blacked out ram
reviews.comment:
It’s a reliable set of 3600mhz ddr4 ram. Low profile so it fits nicely under a Noctua NH-D15. Two pairs play nicely to make 4x8Gb and there is enough air gap between all 4 sticks that it doesn’t get toasty doing prime95.
It also doesn’t hurt how it’s black/grey heat spreaders match nicely with the mentioned CPU cooler. Not like you’ll see them under that massive hunk of metal, but still.
While it would be nice to be given an alternate XMP profile for a tighter timed 3200mhz at maybe CL16, it’s really not a problem that’s worth worrying over. 3600mhz at CL19 is perfectly fine.
If you need low profile “short height” memory for your build and you don’t need RGB lighting, this set of ram is good for your needs.
reviews.author: Mohamad Nazry Bin Noordin

reviews.title: Good ram chips
reviews.comment:
So I used these in my main desktop rig that I do typically computer work and video editing. The price is great and they have different configurations when I last purchased them. Which is another plus. I did have one ram chip go out on me. It took awhile for me to troubleshoot it and find out but once I did I just ordered another one since cost is so low. Been working like a champ ever since.
Nothing special from a installation perspective. Just plug them in. They are low profile for those who may be looking for that type in particular. That's actually another reason I purchased them. The speed that I run these sticks are 3600. So they are good for that. Feels and looks good. So the quality is above average in my opinion.
Would I buy them again? Yes
Would I recommend them? Yes
